full_page.content:
Page 30 Cont.
Mar. 15 Pvt. Robert George - 19 - now 9 months in service - escaped from battle of Iwojima - lay three days in front line after being wounded - is able to walk now .... said to have been miraculous escape. Enrolled several times in Ser. Masses again To-day with comrades ....
W. Howard Roberts - 42 - color'd convert - has fearful head- aches ....
Page 31
Mar. 16 Mildred Nelson - 11 -
Joan Esper - 11 - pneumonia feared
18 Majorie Edgar - 52 - badly lame - trying to care for 80 yr .- old mother - asks for prayers that only son be sent home - honorably discharged - her husband also broke his leg lately - doublly
20 Edward Rieden - 51 - very peculiar pains through head & body and limbs; has been doctoring for three years with very little re- sults .... Enrolled To-day.
20 Andrew McAlear - 64 - gangrenous foot - fears amputation.
Thanks - John Francis Carr - 21 - reported on Sept. 18th '44 "Missing in Action" here To-night thankful to be home. Was en- rolled Sept. 20 on word from Connecticut.
Dr. Gerard
21 Mrs. Cath. Coyne - 55 - very little hope of recovery from Stroke last Friday - anointed yesterday.
Page 32 Mar.21 Child Leon - 14 mo. - cancer .... Vincent Paul Minisci - 44 - operated in Mayo Clinic Rochester - had fearfully swollen leg. Wife made promise to give $100.00 for Poor Souls if things went well .... things did brighten some but not entirely .... she now fulfilles her Promise - hoping for fur- ther improvement - anxious of threatening operation.
Elsie Wheeler - 16 - Episcopelian - came with mother last Wednes- day . She went to theatre (Michigan) and has not shown up since - Enrolled To-day.
